1. (Currently Amended) An assembly comprising a test tube with an affixed MTP, wherein the MTP is embedded in the test tube at a position ensuring that the MTP is oriented for reading downwards.

2. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in the test tube at a position near the center bottom of the container.

3. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the test tube is a biorepository test tube and the MTP is embedded in a material selected from the group consisting of polypropylene and acetal polymer.

4. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in polypropylene or acetal polymer, and the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the test tube. 

5. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath the bottom of the test tube, and oriented for reading downwards.
